name: DNA topoisomerase II beta

function.text: TOP2B is the approved symbol for DNA topoisomerase II beta. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in chromatin binding; DNA topoisomerase type II (double strand cut, ATP-hydrolyzing) activity; B cell differentiation.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include B-cell immunodeficiency, distal limb anomalies, and urogenital malformations (autosomal dominant). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Medulloblastoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; Strong GenCC assertion, Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific review required.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: TOP2B encodes DNA topoisomerase II beta. Its functions include chromatin binding and DNA topoisomerase type II (double strand cut, ATP-hydrolyzing) activity.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include B-cell immunodeficiency, distal limb anomalies, and urogenital malformations (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TOP2B have been reported in medulloblastoma, colorectal carcinoma, and endometrial carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
